title: Syrian Veggie Wrap
description: A delicious and healthy wrap filled with juicy vegetables and flavorful syrian ingredients.
instructions: Heat a pan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add sliced green peppers and cook for 2 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Warm the Syrian wrap in the pan for 1 minute.
Spread 2 tbsp of vegetable hummus on the wrap.
Add the cooked vegetables on top of the hummus.
Add sliced cucumber on top of the vegetables.
Fold the wrap to enclose the filling.
